integrity: Proof and a standard-library reproducer are embedded; numerical tail diagnostics are supplementary and independent validation was not performed.
scientific_limitations: One-step uncompressed Taylor or classical RK endpoint followed by a single exact one-column Gaussian compression on a 2-by-2 rotational Lyapunov flow. Does not analyze the original stage-sketched implementation, global error, finite precision, regularized or oversampled schemes. Previously known indefinite Nyström instability and imaginary-axis stability polynomials are credited.
title: Sharp moment-integrability phases for Gaussian Nyström compression of rotational Runge–Kutta steps
